samples.description: Combined candidate annual firm-year panel for the retained 1996–2000 and 2004–2011 Table 3A fits, after the Compustat/CRSP common-stock intersection, positive observed beginning goodwill screen, and observed joint segment-count/goodwill-decline exclusion. Carries outcome-specific and predictor missingness; transition years are retained only in the source-history construction.

assumptions: Firm GVKEY is the best-effort conditional-logit stratum because the paper does not identify the strata.
ROA average assets uses AT at t−2 and t−1; the source does not state its endpoints.
Goodwill/SPI use reported units when adjacent-year reporting currencies match and own-date USD conversions when reporting currency changes; same-currency ratios remain in reported units.
Fiscal year is the year label; duplicate GVKEY/FYEAR records retain the latest DATADATE.
The segment screen uses the disclosed same-type BUSSEG/OPSEG pair and retains unknown-coverage rows.
Annual price currency is used only when dated primary issue and monthly price checks verify it.

limitations: The paper does not report Table 3 Panel A fit-specific observation counts or conditional-logit strata. Reported Table 1 regime Ns are descriptive comparison points, not fitted-sample targets.

Firm conditioning, fiscal-year matching, the average-assets endpoints, the segment-count/vintage policy, and the exact Compustat/CRSP intersection timing are best-effort choices disclosed in design.md.
Goodwill/SPI currency transitions, same-currency ratios, price-currency verification, and non-USD conversions use the explicit provider-supported basis rules in design.md.
